source: maplestory.io (GMS 270) — skillbook API (jobs 100/110/111/112/114/40001) + raw WZ API; Burning Soul Blade stills from Maple Editors (2019)

counts.note: effectFrames/hitFrames count shared-frame references once per entry (Spirit Calibur 1141501 references 1141500's 11 hit frames); the Unique counts deduplicate by file path.

notes: Frames listed with placeholder=true are 1x1 timing placeholders in the source WZ data; the player skips them.
Sword Illusion effect0 (65 frames) is a blank timing sequence in the WZ and is omitted; its slash/explosion frames live under sub-attacks 400011125/400011126.

HEXA Raging Blow has its own effect/hit frames in GMS 270 (job 114 skillbook: 1141000 17 effect + 6 hit, 1141001 16 effect + 6 hit), distinct from Raging Blow (1121008) frames — corrected 2026-11-15; the earlier "shares 1121008 frames" claim was wrong.
Spirit Calibur 1141501 shares all 11 hit frames with Spirit Calibur 1141500 (identical pixels, delays and origins); they are stored once and referenced, not duplicated.
Burning Soul Blade summon images could not be fetched from maplestory.io (HTTP 500); its 2 Maple Editors 2019 stills are shown as labelled fallbacks and the summon animation is pending.

skills.name: Iron Body
skills.description: Boosts DEF and Max HP by a set percentage, and decreases damage taken when hit by enemies.

skills.name: Guardian Armor
skills.description: Increase Battle Mode ATT based on DEF.

skills.name: Warrior Mastery
skills.description: Trains up your warrior basics to increase Movement Speed, Jump, Max HP, and Max Movement Speed. Also grants a chance to resist knockback.

skills.name: Slash Blast
skills.description: Consumes MP to attack nearby enemies all at once.

skills.name: War Leap
skills.description: Leap once more while already in the air. Press the up key at the same time to move upward.

skills.name: Leap Attack
skills.description:
Ambush the enemy by rapidly dropping to ground from mid-air.
Can only be used if there's a platform within range below you. Use along with a left or right arrow keys to drop yourself diagonally.
Can also be used by pressing the downward, left, or right arrow keys plus the attack key, instead of manually activating the skill.

skills.name: War Leap
skills.description:
Charge through the air to attack the enemy. Can also be used by pressing the upward arrow key plus the attack key.
Right-click to lock command.

skills.name: Weapon Mastery
skills.description: Increases Sword and Axe Mastery, Attack Speed, Final Damage, and Critical Rate.

skills.name: Final Attack
skills.description: Chance to deliver an additional hit after a direct attack skill. Attacks the boss with the highest HP first. Must have a sword or axe equipped.

skills.name: Physical Training
skills.description: Permanently increases STR and DEX through sheer physical training.

skills.name: Combo Attack
skills.description:
When activated, grants a chance to add each attack to the Combo Orb, up to 5.
Right-click to toggle the Combo Orb Effect on/off

skills.name: Agile Arms
skills.description: Increases Attack Speed and Strength.

skills.name: Spirit Blade
skills.description: The sword and the spirit are united to improve the Attack Power of party members including yourself for a short time, and reflect a multiple of the damage that you receive.

skills.name: Brandish
skills.description: [Swordsmanship] Perform a double attack on enemies in front of you.

skills.name: Flash Blade
skills.description: Zip forward in a flash, cutting enemies in your path. Use the arrow keys to charge in any direction. Impervious to Knockback while casting.

skills.name: Self Recovery
skills.description: Regularly recovers some HP and MP, even in combat.

skills.name: Chance Attack
skills.description: Deals greater damage when attacking weakened enemies. Also, permanently increases Critical Rate.

skills.name: Endure
skills.description: Enhances your Abnormal Status Resistance and Elemental Resistance.

skills.name: Combo Synergy
skills.description: Increases Final Damage for each combo orb and increases the chance to gain combo orbs.

skills.name: Scarring Sword
skills.description: Infuses the sword with spirit, which leaves an indelible scar on the enemy.

skills.name: Intrepid Slash
skills.description: [Swordsmanship] Deal 3 consecutive attacks to multiple enemies in front of you.

skills.name: Rush
skills.description: Dashes forward and pushes back multiple monsters. Can be resisted by some monsters.

skills.name: Beam Blade
skills.description: Launches out blades that tear your enemies apart. Use the arrow keys to attack in any direction.

skills.name: Advanced Combo
skills.description: Increases the final damage dealt per combo orb and enables you to gain more orbs. Also grants a chance to gain orbs twice as quickly. Additionally increases mastery.

skills.name: Enrage
skills.description: Focuses your rage into your combo orbs to deal powerful damage to enemies.

skills.name: Combat Mastery
skills.description: Ignores a portion of a monster's defense while attacking.

skills.name: Advanced Final Attack
skills.description: Permanently increases Attack Power. Greatly increases activation rate and damage of Final Attack.

skills.name: Power Stance
skills.description: Concentrates to hold your ground when struck, resisting knock-back effects permanently.

skills.name: Raging Blow
skills.description: Deals multiple blows to enemies in front of you. The final two blows will always be criticals.

skills.name: Advanced Combo Attack - Reinforce
skills.description: Final Damage increased for each additional combo orb.

skills.name: Advanced Combo Attack - Opportunity
skills.description: Increases the chance to charge 2 combo orbs at once.

skills.name: Advanced Combo Attack - Boss Rush
skills.description: Damage increases when attacking Boss Monster for each combo.

skills.name: Advanced Final Attack - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases the damage of Advanced Final Attack.

skills.name: Advanced Final Attack - Ferocity
skills.description: Increases Advanced Final Attack's Attack Power boost.

skills.name: Advanced Final Attack - Opportunity
skills.description: Increases the activation chance of Advanced Final Attack.

skills.name: Raging Blow - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Raging Blow's damage.

skills.name: Raging Blow - Spread
skills.description: Increases the max number of monsters hit by Raging Blow.

skills.name: Raging Blow - Extra Strike
skills.description: Increases Raging Blow's attack count.

skills.name: Maple Warrior
skills.description: The Goddess of Maple World's grace increases your stats. Using the skill briefly makes the Goddess of Maple World appear.

skills.name: Raging Blow
skills.description: [Swordsmanship] Instantly slashes several times to slice multiple enemies in front of you. The final blow will always be a critical hit. The skill is enhanced when combo is fully charged. Additionally enhances Beam Blade.

skills.name: Hero's Will
skills.description:
Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec. after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through. Does not apply Combat Orders.
Can be used while using other skills.

skills.name: Puncture
skills.description: [Swordsmanship] Pour your swordsman's spirit into a forward-downward strike, leaving a wound on your enemy that deals continuous damage for a short time. While taking continuous damage, the enemy will also take more damage.

skills.name: Magic Crash
skills.description:
Chance to remove certain buffs from affected enemies and prevent them regaining those buffs.
Enemies hit will resist Magic Crash for 90 seconds. Buffs Removed: Attack Power & Magic ATT Bonuses, DEF Bonuses, and Obsidian Skin.

skills.name: Rising Rage
skills.description: Manifest the rage of the ancients to wipe out the enemy in front of you.

skills.name: Epic Adventure
skills.description: Call upon the bravery deep within to increase damage output.

skills.name: Cry Valhalla
skills.description: Calls upon the power of the ancients to defend you. Except for common and 5th job skills, your Swordsmanship skills will periodically leave afterimages, which deal additional attacks to the enemy. Sword strikes are created first on the boss with the highest max HP.

skills.name: Cry Valhalla
skills.description: Call upon the power of the ancients to defend you.

skills.name: Burning Soul Blade
skills.description:
Conjures a burning soul blade to fight at your side. Unaffected by attack reflection. Use the skill key with the down arrow key to summon it in a fixed state.
With Action Customization enabled, you can immediately summon in a fixed state by pressing its skill key again, without the use of the arrow keys.
Right-click to toggle Action Customization ON/OFF

skills.name: Worldreaver
skills.description: Unleashes a brutal slash.

skills.name: Instinctual Combo
skills.description: Tap into your subconscious abilities and use your power to its fullest potential. Increases the ability gained from the Combo Orb and allows you to leave a tear in space when Raging Blow is used. Also, Spirit Calibur will leave a soul trace upon hitting an enemy. The tear in space and soul trace are unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Sword Illusion
skills.description: Slice forward faster than the eye can see using a combo orb. Sword Illusion is unaffected by attack reflection.
skills.note: effect0 (65 frames) is a blank timing sequence in the WZ (1x1 frames, delay 1320, empty origin); omitted — maplestory.io skillbook also omits it. Sub-attacks 400011125/400011126 carry the slash/explosion frames.

Lv. 20: Boss Damage +20%
Lv. 30: Ignore Defense +30% and Boss Damage +30%

skills.description:
Unleashes a slash from the pinnacle of sword mastery, where sound itself is cut.

Lv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 20 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +20%
